Comments: A kinship term only on the Samoyedic side. Tundra Nenets jiŕi 'grandfather' and Nganasan iri mean 'grandfather', Proto-Selkup *ira ~ *era means 'man, husband', but also 'old man'. The meaning does make one wonder whether Proto-Selkup has something to do with Iranian *wīra- that underwent *wi > i in the Iranian steppe languages. It's also perhaps notable that Nganasan iri lacks the otherwise regular prothetic nasal.
